_comment: Backend line-coverage floor. A ratchet, not a target: scripts/coverage_gate.py
fails when the FULL backend suite (backend/tests: unit + integration + guardian)
measures BELOW this number. It never fails for being above it, and it never
raises itself -- raising it is a deliberate edit. It may not be lowered without
a `Ratchet-Exempt: <why>` line in the commit message.
Measured 2026-09-19 at commit a61112a and again, unchanged, at 06fd061 (which adds
packages/causal-core and leaves backend/ alone). coverage.py via pytest-cov,
Python 3.12.3, `--cov=src`, so backend/mcp_server is not in the denominator:
full suite  560 tests  4304/5379 statements = 80.01%
unit only   470 tests  4036/5379 statements = 75.03%
Set at the full-suite measurement rounded down to one decimal.
Raised 2026-09-19 to 80.7 after the backend rewire onto causal-core measured
full suite  549 tests  4179/5175 statements = 80.75%.
Lowered 2026-09-20 to 80.6, once CI measured 80.66% on the same commit. The 0.09
difference was environmental: this laptop still had dowhy installed from before the
rewire dropped it as a dependency, so the optional-import branch in
src/skills/causal_structure_compare.py ran here and not on CI. dowhy has been
uninstalled here, both now measure 80.66%, and the floor follows the environment
that CI builds from the declared dependencies -- not whatever a laptop happens to
have lying around.
Why this replaced `--cov-fail-under=80` in backend/pyproject.toml: that flag
applied to every pytest invocation, so the CI unit job (unit tests only,
~75%) could never pass, and running a single test file failed on coverage.
What this number is NOT: evidence that any causal number is right. 560 tests
pass and none of them asserts an estimate against a known ground truth.
Coverage says which lines ran, not whether what they computed is true.

Raised 2026-09-25 to 82.2 after this branch's alignment work and the assumption registry measured the full suite at 634 tests, 4781/5806 statements = 82.35%. 0.15 below the measurement: the 2026-09-20 lesson was that CI can read ~0.1 lower than a laptop on the same commit.
Raised 2026-09-25 to 83.0 after the role matrix and domain scope (db89e78) measured the full suite at 741 tests, 4956/5956 statements = 83.21%. 0.21 below the measurement, for the same reason.

Raised 2026-09-26 to 84.0 after septa-52 (2386e15, the suite on PostgreSQL too) measured the full SQLite suite at 836 tests, 5178/6142 statements = 84.30%. 0.30 below the measurement: CI and local runs have differed by up to ~0.2.
